description: Serializable view of the leading components of a `YieldPca` fit.

cumulative_variance.description: Cumulative explained-variance fraction through each leading component.

explained_variance_ratio.description: Fraction of total variance explained by each leading component.

loadings.description: Row-major loadings `loadings[tenor][k]` for the leading components.

mean_change.description: Column means subtracted from the yield changes before PCA (one per tenor).

scores.description: Row-major scores `scores[t][k]` (one row per yield-change observation).

tenors.description: Tenor grid in years, in loading-row order.

title: YieldPcaView
